as 353 kg1 m3=345 kgx m3, or 353=345x. Multiplying both sides of this equation by x yields 353x=345. Dividing both sides of this equation by 353 yields x=345353. Therefore, the volume of this sample is 345353 m3. Since it’s given that the sample of this type of wood is a cube, it follows that the length of one edge of this sample can be found using the volume formula for a cube, V=s3, where V represents the volume, in m3, and s represents the length, in m, of one edge of the cube. Substituting 345353for V in this formula yields 345353=s3. Taking the cube root of both sides of this equation yields 3453533=s, or s≈0.99. Therefore, the length of one edge of this sample to the nearest hundredth of a meter is 0.99 .
